entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand sensor. Your return policy is an absolute joke and I want my money back now.
I can certainly look into that return for you. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It doesn't matter what the issue is! I don't want it! We had a family emergency, my husband was rushed to the hospital and I haven't had a second to even think about this stupid thing. It's completely unacceptable.
I'm very sorry to hear about the situation with your husband. I certainly hope he is doing okay. Let me just pull up your order details and I'll see what we can do for you.

Don't 'see what you can do'. Just do it! He's facing a major surgery and his upcoming deployment is in jeopardy. This is the last thing I need to be fighting about. Get me a manager, now! I'm about to leave a review on every website imaginable about how VeloFit treats military families.

Ma'am, I understand your frustration, but there's no need for a manager. I think I can resolve this for you right now. I've just pulled up your account, and I can see the VeloBand Cadence Sensor was delivered just five days ago.
And? Your policy is what, ten days? It's ridiculous!
I apologize for any confusion. Our policy for this item is actually a 90-day return window. Since you're only on day five, you are well within the timeframe for a full refund. No exception is needed.
Wait, what? Ninety days? Are you sure? The site I looked at said something else. So... you're just going to approve it?

Yes, absolutely. I've just processed the return authorization. A prepaid shipping label has been sent to the email address we have on file. Simply package the item back up, attach the label, and drop it in the mail. Once we receive it, you'll see the full refund within 3-5 business days.
Oh. Okay. Well... thank you, Charlie. I'm sorry for yelling, it's just been a very stressful time.
I completely understand. Please don't worry about it. Again, I wish your husband a swift recovery. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's it. Thank you for your help.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
